<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 99.2 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>Sagard Holdings Manager (US) LLC </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>280 Park Avenue, 34th Floor West </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>New York, NY 10017 </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">September&nbsp;30,
2026 </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Sagard Private Income Fund Inc. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">280 Park Avenue, 34th
Floor West </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">New York, NY 10017 </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Attn: Christopher Millin
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Re: Waiver of Certain Advisory Fees </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Dear
Mr.&nbsp;Millin: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Reference is hereby made to the Investment Advisory Agreement, dated September&nbsp;30, 2026 (as may be amended and
restated from time to time, the &#8220;<B><I>Investment Advisory Agreement</I></B>&#8221;), by and between Sagard Private Income Fund Inc. (the &#8220;<B><I>Fund</I></B>&#8221;) and Sagard Holdings Manager (US) LLC (the
&#8220;<B><I>Adviser</I></B>&#8221;). Capitalized terms used but not defined herein shall have the meaning ascribed to them in the Investment Advisory Agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Effective immediately and through the date of the twelve-month anniversary of the Fund&#8217;s BDC Election Date (the &#8220;<B><I>Advisory
Fee Waiver Period</I></B>&#8221;), the Adviser hereby agrees to calculate the Base Management Fee as indicated below (referred to below as the &#8220;<B><I>Reduced Base Management Fee</I></B>&#8221;) and to permanently waive such portion of the Base
Management Fee that is in excess of the Reduced Base Management Fee that the Adviser would otherwise be entitled to receive under the Investment Advisory Agreement. No portion of the Base Management Fee waived shall be subject to recoupment. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">During the Advisory Fee Waiver Period, the Reduced Base Management Fee shall be payable quarterly in arrears and shall be calculated at an
annual rate of 0.85% of the average monthly value of the Fund&#8217;s net assets during the most recently completed calendar quarter. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">*&#8195;&#8195;&#8195; *&#8195;&#8195;&#8195;* </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Waiver Letter shall be governed, construed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the State of New York, <U>provided</U>,
<U>however</U>, that nothing herein shall be construed as being inconsistent with the 1940 Act. To the extent the applicable laws of the State of New York, or any of the provisions herein, conflict with the provisions of the 1940 Act, the latter
shall control. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Waiver Letter may be terminated only by the Fund, by the vote of the Board of Directors of the Fund (the
&#8220;<B><I>Board</I></B>&#8221;), including the vote of all of the members of the Board who are not &#8220;interested persons&#8221; (as such term is defined in Section&nbsp;2(a)(19) of the 1940 Act) of the Fund. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Waiver Letter may be executed in one or more counterparts, and by the different parties hereto in separate counterparts, each of which
when executed shall be deemed to be an original but all of which taken together shall constitute one and the same agreement. Counterparts may be delivered by <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> (including Portable Document Format (.pdf)
or any electronic signature complying with the Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce (ESIGN) Act of 2000 (e.g., www.docusign.com)) or other transmission method, and any counterpart so delivered shall be deemed to constitute an
original signature, have been duly and validly delivered and be deemed the same as a handwritten signature for the purposes of validity, enforceability and admissibility pursuant to the ESIGN Act, the Uniform Electronic Transactions Act (UETA) model
law or similar applicable laws. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">[<I>Signature page to follow</I>] </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:12pt; margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
